purpose: Create the reusable protected shell and keep all runner/E2E proof needed for its complete navigation/logout outcome with that implementation.
success_outcome: Protected pages share one server-authoritative navigation shell whose logout closes the session and whose browser proof cannot touch the real database.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement the existing logout route or session lifecycle.
Do not implement Home, Classes, Statistics, or Profile page behavior in the layout.
Do not change the ordinary real-database Playwright smoke.
constraints: The layout is a transport/presentation adapter over request-local server actor context.
Logout behavior stays on the existing POST /auth/logout owner and is proved as integration delta, not reimplemented.
Focused browser state is disposable and ordinary npm run e2e behavior remains unchanged.
invariants: No client-supplied role or scope controls shell visibility.
The old session cannot authorize a protected request after logout.
A focused browser gate owns one server and one tmp database and never opens or removes study-calendar.db.
